name: Don Hall
headline: Vice President - Professional Services at Epicor Software
about:
I’m an operations and services executive focused on scaling organizations, modernizing delivery models, and driving predictable growth across ERP and SaaS environments.
 
Over the past 19+ years, I’ve led multi-region professional services organizations with full P&L accountability, consistently delivering strong revenue performance while improving operational discipline, forecasting accuracy, and customer outcomes. My experience spans building teams from the ground up, transforming legacy delivery models, and aligning sales, services, and customer success into a cohesive growth engine.
 
A core theme throughout my career has been transformation at scale—whether that’s shifting to hybrid delivery models, leading enterprise system implementations, or introducing AI-driven approaches to services scoping and commercial operations. I’m particularly interested in how data, automation, and AI can improve decision-making, increase efficiency, and create more predictable business performance.
 
I enjoy building high-performing teams, developing future leaders, and creating operating models that can scale across geographies and markets. I’ve had the opportunity to work across North America and LATAM, supporting complex ERP transformations for a wide range of clients.
 
If you’re focused on scaling services organizations, improving operational performance, or driving transformation initiatives, I’d welcome the conversation.
